item: row 339 (R800): trust decisions from another installation's backup need a click
key_paths: src/backup/merge.py; src/annotations/store.py; src/api/annotations.py; src/reporting/evidence.py; src/static/app-home.js; src/static/oo-on.js; tests/test_merge_imported_annotations.py
summary: a restore applies imported authors' trust flags automatically only from an artifact signed with this installation's own key (is_this_installations_key, which never creates a key); from any other verified key the authors import untrusted and the record carries a trust_withheld marker naming that key, the report counts and lists them with the reason and the signer (an unattended queue lists them and never applies), and the web-of-trust list asks once per key with the fingerprint and the count, No focused first; Import them applies them only while the count still matches what was shown (else 409, nothing changed), No clears the question and leaves them untrusted; no re-read of the backup is needed; an existing local record is never touched; a backup's own copy of the marker is dropped; a manual trust toggle settles it; an unsigned or unverified backup is withheld with no offer, as before; strings x12.
